name: Can an in-law suite be built over a garage in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Can an in-law suite be built over a garage in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Can an in-law suite be built over a garage in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: An in-law suite above a garage can work well when the site and structure support it, but it is usually more complex than a ground-level conversion. The design must account for structural loads, fire separation, stair placement, sound transfer, and safe access. Utility routing also becomes more complicated when the living space sits above an existing garage. This type of project can be a strong option when yard space is limited, but it should only move forward after a structural and code review. Homeowners should compare it against a ground-level addition or conversion, because the cheapest-looking option is not always the best once framing and engineering are included.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, an over-garage suite can be possible, but it usually requires stronger structural design, better sound control, and careful fire and stair planning. It is often more complex and costly than a ground-level conversion. Feasibility depends on the garage structure, access, and zoning constraints.
